name: @red-cup-engineering/read-hive-account-history-service
description: Reads a Hive account's operation history, paged from two independent public nodes via condenser_api.get_account_history and witnessed against each other, filtered to the standard ledger-relevant operation kinds and an optional time range, with every VESTS-carrying field also carried as HP at the chain's vests-to-HP ratio (the operation's own embedded conversion when it carries one, else the current chain ratio, both stated so a consumer never confuses the two).
